_about: Rules, regulations and notifications made under the Companies Act, 2017, with the sections they carry out. `library` names the instrument's id when its text is in the library; `sections` lists the Act's sections; `basis` says where the link comes from; `confirm` lists what still has to be checked against the instrument itself. Sections cited by instruments in the library are found automatically and need not be listed here. `url` links to the instrument's page on the regulator's website; `found` records how the details were found (`search-index`: from a web search engine's index of the regulator's site, to be confirmed against the instrument).

instruments.basis: Section 88(1) lets a company buy back its shares “subject to … the regulations specified in this behalf”. Unlisted companies are covered by the Companies Regulations, 2024.
